title: A field camera setup: res/field/cameras/setups/<n>.json
description: Camera setup n of ARCID_FIELD_CAMERA_DEFAULT (a/0/5/9), which a zone names by its "camera" and FieldCamera_CoordsLoadDefaults applies. tools/data/field_camera_data.py packs them in order.

distance.description: The camera's distance from its target, in whole units

fov.description: Half the field of view of a perspective camera, in 65536ths of a turn

buffer_mode.description: The depth buffer's mode, GX_BUFFERMODE_Z or GX_BUFFERMODE_W

bind.description: Whether the camera follows what it is bound to (the player), at target from it, or looks at target

target.description: With bind, the target's offset from what the camera follows; without, the target

angle.description: An angle in 65536ths of a turn

fx32.description: In 4096ths of a unit, as the game's fixed-point numbers
